### Bible Pathways - Jan. 30, 2008
Author: Bible Pathway Ministries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathways-jan-30-2008-11566288.html
Passage: Exodus 38:1
Points:
- Bezalel built the bronze altar of burnt offering as the place of atoning sacrifice before God.
- The perpetually burning fire shows that sinners may come to God through Christ at any time.
- The bronze construction symbolizes God's holy judgment against human sin.
- Old Testament sacrifices pointed to Jesus Christ as the true Lamb of God offered for our sins.
- Christ serves as both the mediating High Priest and the complete sacrifice providing reconciliation.
